t2.thesis: MSFT enters the print near highs with a roughly 5% implied move and a mixed recent earnings-reaction history, so the outcome is close to a coin flip with a slight lean to the base rate.
reasons: Base rate for AMC and software events is about 54%, and nothing in the dossier shifts it decisively.
Last four prints had a 25% win rate on the open-to-open measure, with three of the four negative despite EPS beats, which suggests a high bar.
The previous quarter was strong (Azure +43%, RPO +84%) and the stock is 2.4% below its 52w high, so expectations are elevated.
Tech sentiment is positive into the print (Anthropic IPO filing, tech up two days), which offsets the high-bar concern.
Implied move of about 5% is large relative to 60-day realized vol of 22%, so the options market is pricing a big move but with no clear direction signal.
t2.deciding_variable: Azure growth and the capex/margin outlook relative to elevated expectations, plus Q2 guidance.

prior.from: I3 overall validation hit rate 0.542 (AMC 0.538, software_internet 0.541); used ~0.54
